Part 5B: Making Your Own Reamers (2)

by Richard Maguire | Aug 7, 2026 | 1 comment

This video is part 5b of a 6 part course:

Gearing Up For Chair Making: Pt 5b

DOWNLOAD THE DRAWING TO BUILD YOUR OWN: METRIC | IMPERIAL

Follow on YouTube

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:04
Instaread

My goal for this course is to equip you with the knowledge and tools to design & build your own chairs from scratch.
Once this is complete, I’ll come up with some projects so we can put it all into use.

These six videos will get you well prepared.

The full (free) 6 part course at a glance:

‘Gearing Up For Chair Making’

  • Pt 1) Understanding Chair Joinery: Tapered Round Joints
  • Pt 2) Reamers & Tenon Cutters: Use & Applications [Shop bought vs Homemade]
  • Pt 3) The ‘V-Block’: A Simple Workholding Gizmo for Chair Making
  • Pt 4) Perfect Spindles Without A Lathe: Making the ‘Chair Maker’s Shooting Board’
  • Pt 5) [in two videos] Making Your Own Reamers: Two Variations
  • Pt 6) Making Your Own Tenon Cutters

Subscribe or follow on YouTube to stay updated.
